session_read: Fresh intraday sweep at 10:55 ET, requested after this morning's run. The book was rebuilt today: 32 names from 28, with ~$7.5k deployed across 12 buys in a 50-minute window after the open and two stop-loss sells ahead of them. Every one of the 15 trades is captured with an exact email-confirmed fill and a stated reason -- the first run in weeks with nothing left UNCAPTURED. The deployment did what it was meant to: cash fell 22.5% to 7.33% and is back inside its band, the AI Networking/Optics underweight was cured outright, and drawdown healed from -6.04% to -3.82%. It also cost something specific and worth naming -- aggregate open risk went from 9.77% to 12.44% against a 10% cap, and names sitting over their own ATR cap went from five to nine. Of today's +$7,317, only $2,274 is market move; the rest is money you put in. This is the first live run of the new non-ATR triggers, and they immediately surfaced two trades the old engine structurally could not: booking profit on MSFT (+24.7% on the month, RSI 78.8) and BX (+16.5%, RSI 71.1), neither of which is over its risk cap. The oversold screen correctly stayed empty -- META is oversold at RSI 34.1 but carries a WATCH thesis, and the gate refused it as a falling knife rather than a dip. Read the analytical sections with a caveat: all four analyst agents failed twice on a platform-wide API overload, so there is no thesis pass, no news, no catalyst and no strategist this run, and therefore no new proposals. The arithmetic is sound; the judgment layer is missing and labelled as such rather than filled in.
